issue.title: [rsyslog] ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service during installing image by onie

failure.body:
#### Description

When install sonic image by onie, sometimes it raises error log like "ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service"._

The issue is due to a very rare timing issue, where rsyslog was started by systemd and before starting can complete, ZTP detects /etc/sonic/config_db.json and shuts down all process including rsyslog resulting to a parallel start stop and leading to errors. But eventually rsyslog gets restarted Here is the sequence

Feb  8 <IPV6>.084735 sonic INFO systemd[1]: Starting Update rsyslog configuration...
Feb  8 <IPV6>.555834 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Stopping System Logging Service...
Feb  8 <IPV6>.568028 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Succeeded.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.568573 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Stopped System Logging Service.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.570550 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Starting System Logging Service...
Feb  8 <IPV6>.573292 r-tigon-04 NOTICE systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Feb  8 <IPV6>.573428 r-tigon-04 WARNING systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.574127 r-tigon-04 ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.576389 r-tigon-04 INFO sonic-ztp[22060]: Job for rsyslog.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.576477 r-tigon-04 INFO sonic-ztp[22060]: See "systemctl status rsyslog.service" and "journalctl -xe" for details.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.600999 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: ztp.service: Succeeded.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.700135 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Scheduled restart job, restart counter is at 1.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.700459 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Stopped System Logging Service.
Feb  8 <IPV6>.702382 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Starting System Logging Service...
Feb  8 <IPV6>.703573 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Succeeded.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Install image by onie
2. Check syslog

#### Describe the results you received:
There is error log raised as below:
**_ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service_**

#### Describe the results you expected:

resolution.title: [ztp] Fix race between ztp and rsyslog-config
resolution.description:
- ZTP service restarts rsyslog service when it is shutting down. There
       can be a situation where rsyslog-config service is operational and
       restarting rsyslog.service.

     - The proposed changes start ztp.service after rsyslog-config.service
       exits.

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13798
